events.patches.description: GET /events?patches=1 sends device_patch events carrying only the fields that changed.

events.telemetry_off.description: GET /events?telemetry=0 leaves telemetry fields out of device records and sends field-name notices instead.

events.telemetry_fields.description: GET /events?telemetry=name,name sends only the named telemetry fields; the rest arrive as notices.

events.opt_out.description: GET /events?meters=0 leaves out meter_values and shure_meter_values; telemetry=none leaves out telemetry fields and their notices. The server skips building events no connected client wants.

conmon_association.description: Device records carry cmc_source_identifier, cmc_process, cmc_process_state, association_state and association_generation. ConMon updates require one current advertised source identifier and process owner. Address devices by server_name. Managed sources without direct CMC discovery have no ConMon association.
